premises: Nanohierarchical architecture with composition undulation can be introduced in a high-entropy alloy.
This architecture yields ultralow wear rate (10^-7 to 10^-6 mm^3/Nm) and reduced friction across RT to 800°C.
The mechanism is multi-type adaptive friction interface protection from nano-coupled grains and nanoprecipitates.
This protection releases gradient frictional stress and activates a nanocrystalline glaze layer at high temperature.
The approach is applicable to other alloy systems beyond the demonstrated Ni50(AlNbTiV)50.
